title: Srirangam Vaishnavite Temple
subject: History
caption: Diagram of Srirangam Vaishnavite Temple showing its key architectural elements and its designation as a Swayam Vyakta Kshetra and Divyadesam.
altText: A photorealistic educational textbook illustration on a white background depicting the Srirangam Vaishnavite Temple. The image shows an overhead plan and a side cutaway view, with each structure clearly labelled: the towering Rajagopuram at the entrance, the inner sanctum (Garbhagriha) topped by a Vimana, multiple concentric Prakaras (enclosure walls), and various Mandapas including a Kalyana Mandapa. Annotations indicate the temple's special status as a Swayam Vyakta Kshetra (self-manifested sacred site) and as a Divyadesam (one of the 108 holy Vishnu shrines). The labels are color‑coded and accompanied by a legend, providing a high‑resolution, accurate visual guide to the temple's architecture.
